head.title: Win GTA VI with $FLYAI
head.lede: Half of fly.ai's fees go into a pot. Every time it reaches $70, one GTA VI copy is drawn among $FLYAI holders. The more you hold, the better your odds. Runs until GTA VI comes out on 19 November.

how.title: How it works
how.pot: The pot. Half of the Fly Desk fees (from 22 October) and half of the $FLYAI creator fees from Pons (from 18 October) go in. Each $70 is one copy.
how.who: Who's in. Every wallet with at least 100,000 $FLYAI, held or staked. Team wallets, Fly Wallets and contracts are left out.
how.odds: Odds. Each $FLYAI is one ticket: 500,000 $FLYAI has five times the chance of 100,000.
how.fair: Fair draw. When the bar fills, the list of holders is fixed first. A block mined a few minutes later picks the winner, so nobody can know it in advance. The list and the block are shown with every draw.
how.claim: Winning. Sign in with the winning wallet and leave an email, Discord or X handle so we can send your copy. Wallets that farm or split holdings can be skipped, and the copy is drawn again.
